subject: Ciências da Natureza e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Avaliar, com ou sem o uso de dispositivos e aplicativos digitais, tecnologias e possíveis soluções para as demandas que envolvem a geração, o transporte, a distribuição e o consumo de energia elétrica, considerando a disponibilidade de recursos, a eficiência energética, a relação custo/benefício, as características geográficas e ambientais, a produção de resíduos e os impactos socioambientais e culturais.

components.description_pt: Avaliar tecnologias para gerar, transmitir e distribuir energia elétrica considerando eficiência e impacto ambiental
components.description_en: Evaluate technologies for generating, transmitting, and distributing electrical energy considering efficiency and environmental impact
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the efficiency of an energy-conversion device by analyzing energy input and output

components.description_pt: Comparar soluções de design concorrentes para uso de energia ou recursos minerais baseadas em análise custo-benefício quantitativa
components.description_en: Compare competing design solutions for energy or mineral resource use based on quantitative cost-benefit analysis
components.cc_component_description: Compare competing design solutions for energy or mineral resource use based on quantitative cost-benefit analysis

components.description_pt: Analisar impactos socioambientais e culturais de diferentes tecnologias de energia elétrica
components.description_en: Analyze socioenvironmental and cultural impacts of different electrical energy technologies
components.cc_component_description: Assess potential social, cultural, and environmental impacts of a proposed engineering solution

components.description_pt: Propor soluções para consumo de energia elétrica considerando características geográficas e ambientais
components.description_en: Propose solutions for electrical energy consumption considering geographic and environmental characteristics
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate proposed solutions for reducing human environmental impacts against defined criteria and constraints

cc_matches.description: Evaluate competing design solutions for developing, managing, and utilizing energy and mineral resources based on cost-benefit ratios.
Design, build, and refine a device that works within given constraints to convert one form of energy into another form of energy.

Evaluate a solution to a complex real-world problem based on prioritized criteria and trade-offs that account for a range of constraints, including cost, safety, reliability, and aesthetics as well as possible social, cultural, and environmental impacts.
Design, evaluate, and refine a solution for reducing the impacts of human activities on the environment and biodiversity.
